meta_state_law_citations_007.answer:
The following leave regulations, compliant with the public school laws of Maryland and the bylaws of the State Board of Education, apply to all unit members.
A unit member receiving workers' compensation benefits but not receiving workers' compensation leave may use his/her accrued sick leave and must submit to the Board all monies received through the Workers' Compensation Law of Maryland, or resulting from a legal liability of a person other than the unit member.

meta_cites_federal_law_008.answer:
This Article shall conform to the requirements of the Family and Medical Leave Act of 1993 (FMLA).
Authorized leave under this Article conforming to the FMLA definition of “serious health condition” shall be counted as FMLA leave up to the maximum 12 weeks in each year.
Summer non-duty days and holidays do not count towards the 12 weeks of FMLA.
Reassignment upon return from an approved FMLA leave will be to the unit member’s original position held prior to leave, or to an equivalent position if the original position has been eliminated.
Leave approved and verified with a doctor's certification on an FMLA leave request form in accordance with the FMLA, may be taken for the first 12 weeks of the requested leave.
For unit members on FMLA leave, MCPS will maintain the employee’s benefits under the conditions coverage would have been provided if the employee had continued working.
